title: AI Summarized 50 Unread Emails in 10 Seconds — My New Workflow #shorts #ai
hook: I let AI summarize 50 unread emails in 10 seconds. Inbox zero, no time lost.
description:
I let AI summarize 50 unread emails in 10 seconds. Inbox zero, no time lost.

The stack: Gmail API plus a local Claude instance through Cursor. The AI scans subject and body, ranks by urgency, and writes a 1-line action item per email. Total processing time for 50 emails: 9.4 seconds on my test run.

In this video: the exact pipeline, the urgency scoring rule, and 2 emails the AI got wrong.

🔔 Subscribe @aitoolsdaily — 1 new AI tool tested every day at 8 AM PT.

⚠️ Personal workflow. Test on a sample folder before connecting to your live inbox.

scenes.voiceover: Before: I spent 45 minutes every morning triaging email. Most of it was newsletters and notifications I would skip anyway.

scenes.voiceover: The stack: Gmail API connected to a local Claude instance through Cursor. AI reads subject and body, no attachments. Pure text only.
scenes.visual_prompt: Workflow diagram showing email API connecting to AI processor with output arrows, modern infographic style, photorealistic

scenes.voiceover: AI ranks each email by urgency. Score 0 to 10. Anything below 4 gets auto-archived. Anything above 7 hits a separate priority folder.
scenes.visual_prompt: Priority sorting dashboard with color-coded urgency scores, modern minimal UI design, dark theme, photorealistic

scenes.voiceover: Output per email: one line action item. Example: client wants invoice resent. Action: forward to billing, mark followup tomorrow.

scenes.voiceover: Two emails the AI got wrong: a contract amendment marked low priority, and a fake invoice scored as urgent. Always sanity check before delete.
